messages:
sophie.sales: Quick heads-up — BigRiver Bank asked for a compliance bundle for the POC. They want SOC 2 excerpt, ISO network diagram, and a signed pen-test acceptance letter. Deadline: EOD Friday. Can we confirm what we can share and who signs the pen-test letter?

jordan.se: We can provide SOC2 excerpt & iso diagram. For pen-test letter — legal usually signs the attestation, security provides the template. @maria.security can confirm signer and any redlines.

maria.security: We can sign the standard pen-test acceptance (we have template). Questions: is the POC on Hosted API or Dedicated? If Dedicated / single-tenant, we need to include capacity pricing impact in answer. Also need to know if they require AWS network diagram with VPC peering details.

sophie.sales: POC prefers dedicated for isolation — they asked about single-tenant pricing. Sales asked for a one-off quote. Can we get a quick estimate and a list of additional artifacts we should surface?

ajax: (note: alex.sales message coming)

alex.sales: Quick pricing note: single-tenant (1x reserved pool) adds ~monthly +$12k baseline + onetime setup. If they want on-prem install, that’s a different SOW. I can draft the number but need confirmation about logging/audit retention (affects storage fees).

jordan.se: For artifacts: include SOC2 excerpt PDF, ISO network diagram (we have a template), pen-test letter (signed by Legal + Security), and a short ops runbook for staging creds & presigned upload. Also call out whether KMS is customer-managed.

sophie.sales: They asked specifically about presigned upload for evidence. Can someone paste the curl example we recommend?

devops-bot: presigned example cached — see below:

```bash
# presigned upload example
curl -X PUT "https://s3.redwood-internal.example/bucket/path?X-Amz-Signature=..." \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/zip" \ 
  --data-binary @evidence.zip
```

jordan.se: +1 to that example. Also flag: for Dedicated POC we provision staging IPs and ephemeral KMS creds. That adds ~2 business days ops work; mention that to customer.

maria.security: On signer: I'll route the letter to Legal + Security SME. Legal typically signs the attestation but we stamp it from Security. If they require a custom NDA or signatory change, that adds review time (~3-5 business days).

sophie.sales: Can someone assemble a minimal bundle (SOC2 excerpt, iso diagram, pen-test template, ops runbook) so I can upload to their dataroom? I can do upload once we have presigned link.

jordan.se: I'll assemble ISO diagram + ops runbook. @maria.security can you attach signed pen-test template when ready and confirm any redlines?

maria.security: Will do. ETA 48 hours for signed pen-test letter unless Legal needs changes.

alex.sales: I'll draft a concise pricing note for the customer: baseline +12k/mo for dedicated, +onetime setup $3k, potential storage retention fees. I’ll post a PRD message with numbers.

sophie.sales: Thanks team — calling out blockers for the call tomorrow: 1) signed pen-test letter, 2) final quote for dedicated, 3) presigned upload link. If any of these slip, they might pause the POC. :warning:

jordan.se: Noted. I'll prioritize the runbook and diagram today.

maria.security: I'll escalate signer to Legal now.

devops-bot: presigned link request queued — ops will respond in #eng-infra within 2 hours. :gear:
